paragraphs: Rav Acha bar Tachlifa objected to Rava, Sanhedrin 24, end of a; spoke to Ravina, Gittin 73a. Rav Acha bar Yaakov; Rav Acha bar Ika; Rav Acha of Difti. In Rava’s name, Eruvin 68b. He told Abaye, “The one who permitted it for you…” there, 100a. Jerusalem Talmud, Ma'aser Sheni, chapter 4, halakhah 7, and chapter Ha'omer: Abba bar Tachlifa and Adda bar Tachlifa; see there. Perhaps errors for Acha bar Tachlifa; see Rabbah bar Tachlifa
